extDescription.message: Turns text you choose on any page into links that open a Claude Desktop session with the message ready.

emptyList.message: No pages yet. Click + to add one.

folderTip.message: Optional. If empty, the link has no folder and Claude Desktop opens in its default folder.

hintSlash.message: Starting the value with “/” does not work: Claude Desktop replaces the slash. Ask for the skill in words, e.g. “Run the skill X on Y”.

runTitle.message: Run now: apply this rule to the open tab

noPermTitle.message: Open the page and click Save to allow the extension on this site.

reNothing.message: `*`, `+`, `?` or `{n}` with nothing before it to repeat

reRangeNum.message: range `{min,max}` with min greater than max

reRangeChar.message: range in `[a-z]` with the start after the end

looseQuant.message: Heads up: `{0}` is not a quantifier here; it looks for the literal text "{0}". Use `{0,{1}}` or `{1,{1}}`.

openTab.message: Open a tab on `{0}` and click the extension icon to run it.

runOne.message: 1 match became a link in this tab.

runMany.message: {0} matches became links in this tab.

noMatch.message: The key does not match any visible text in this tab. Check the regex.

allLinked.message: The {0} matching snippets are already links.

splitText.message: The key matches {0} time(s) in the text, but the snippet is split across page elements (e.g. part bold or a link) and did not become a link.

runFailed.message: Could not run in this tab: {0}
